meta.description: Prepare evidence-bounded, constructive peer-review drafts and structured manuscript assessments for authorized review of scientific manuscripts, protocols, preprints, or research proposals. Covers reporting-guideline selection, claim-evidence checks, methods/statistics/reproducibility critique, ethics/integrity review, figure/table/citation audit, and revision-response planning. Strong confidentiality boundaries and human accountability requirements.

scientific_integrity.detail: Exceptional integrity framework: mandatory authorization checks, confidentiality boundaries, human accountability, no fabrication, evidence-bounded critique

practice_boundaries.detail: Clear scope with 11-point never-do list including no impersonation, no external services without permission, no decision announcements, no fabrication

methodological_ground.detail: Based on COPE/ICMJE ethical review practices, current reporting guidelines (CONSORT, PRISMA, etc.), statistical reproducibility standards

code_usability.detail: Production-ready with 7 bundled CLIs (intake validation, guideline selection, claim-evidence matrix, statistics audit, citation check, scaffold, lint)

functional_suitability.note: Complete peer review workflow: intake validation, guideline selection, claim-evidence mapping, methods/statistics/ethics review, figure/citation audit, scaffold generation, lint

reliability.note: Excellent safety with intake gate blocking unauthorized/conflicted/external-service reviews, local-only guarantee, no echo of manuscript text in CLI output

performance_context.note: Efficient local-only processing with bounded JSON/CSV/Markdown inputs, no network/model/API calls; SKILL.md 289 lines well-organized

agent_usability.note: Outstanding: 11-step workflow, mandatory safety boundary section, intake template, 7 CLI tools with schemas, reference file mapping, actionability structure

human_usability.note: Clear triggers (peer review, manuscript, protocol, preprint), confidentiality prominent, authorization gate upfront, human accountability emphasized

security.note: Exceptional: confidentiality boundaries, no external service upload, no .env/API key reading, no network calls, CLI output redacts manuscript text

maintainability.note: Excellent structure: 5 reference files, dated source ledger (2026-07-23), 7 CLIs with exit codes documented, templates in assets/, COPE/ICMJE grounding

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with evidence-bounded critique; deterministic tools; minor: integration with literature search could be more explicit

inputs.label: Intake validation with authorization and conflict checks

assertions.text: validate_review_intake.py blocks until status READY_FOR_LOCAL_REVIEW
assertions.note: Hard gate prevents unauthorized or unsafe reviews

assertions.text: Checks: authorization, accountability, conflicts, venue policy, AI permission, no external services, no reuse, deletion plan
Validates declarations not truth (human still accountable)
Template in assets/review_intake_template.json

inputs.label: Reporting guideline selection and coverage audit

assertions.text: select_reporting_guidelines.py with study profile input
Coverage output as CSV with item-by-item assessment
Critical distinction: completeness ≠ quality/bias/merit
Never convert missing items to automatic score or judgment

inputs.label: Claim-evidence matrix validation
inputs.note: Systematic mapping of claims to supporting evidence

assertions.text: validate_claim_evidence.py processes claim matrix CSV
Prioritizes central, causal, mechanistic, safety, diagnostic, prediction, generalization claims
Report emits IDs and counts, not claim text (confidentiality)
Template in assets/claim_evidence_matrix_template.csv
audit_statistics_reproducibility.py with JSON input
9-point assessment: question, design, allocation, sample size, missingness, assumptions, multiplicity, uncertainty, interpretation
Request specialist review when method exceeds competence
Template in assets/statistical_reproducibility_template.json
audit_citations.py checks [@ref-id] against references CSV
Checks key consistency and identifier format only
assertions.note: Appropriate scope: not verifying source existence or claim support

assertions.text: Template in assets/citation_references_template.csv
Does not verify that source supports claim (outside tool scope)
assertions.note: Limitation stated but human review requirement could be more prominent

inputs.label: Review scaffold generation and lint with channel separation
inputs.note: Draft generation with actionability and tone checks

assertions.text: generate_review_scaffold.py creates separated Markdown draft
assertions.note: Comments to authors and confidential editor sections separated

assertions.text: lint_review.py checks channel separation, placeholders, abusive language, actionability
Emits line numbers and rule IDs, not review text (confidentiality)
All 7 CLIs verified in scripts/ directory
assertions.note: CLIs referenced throughout but directory not fully verified

key_strengths: Exceptional ethical framework: mandatory authorization/confidentiality boundaries, 11-point never-do list, intake gate, human accountability, COPE/ICMJE grounding
Outstanding security and confidentiality: all CLIs redact manuscript text from output, no external service calls, no .env/API key reading, local-only guarantee
Comprehensive workflow with 7 specialized CLIs covering intake, guidelines, claim-evidence, statistics, citations, scaffold, lint with templates for each
Strong scientific rigor: critical distinction that completeness ≠ quality, competence-boundary acknowledgment, evidence-bounded critique, anti-fabrication emphasis
Excellent structure with 11-step workflow, 5 reference files, dated source ledger (2026-07-23), exit code documentation, actionability requirements

recommendations.title: Strengthen integration guidance with paper-lookup skill
recommendations.problem: Citation audit checks format but not whether source supports claim; integration with literature lookup for verification not explicitly guided
recommendations.root_cause: Skills designed independently without cross-skill workflow documentation
recommendations.fix: Add reference/literature_verification.md showing how to use paper-lookup skill to verify citation existence and content without leaking manuscript text (search by DOI/PMID, not claim text)

recommendations.title: Add prominence to citation audit scope limitation
recommendations.problem: Citation audit checks consistency not claim support; limitation stated but human verification requirement could be clearer
recommendations.root_cause: Tool description focuses on what it does rather than what it doesn't
recommendations.fix: Add callout in audit_citations.py --help and SKILL.md: 'This tool checks citation keys exist in reference list, not whether the cited source actually supports the claim. Reviewers must verify claim-citation alignment independently.'
